searchText: @Michah won't like it 😉 But apropos <@!689161464829050960>'s comment here https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/4959#issuecomment-1088844284 I'd suggest a brief Informational EIP noting the rarity of this event and pointing at the now-closed EIPs. I'd love an Informational EIP that has all the joke EIPs as assets. Are you up for writing one? I'll merge it. Sure! Where did your link go? I can't get it to open discord properly :\ 🙂 The one in the PR itself The discord link went here. The other was to your comment on PR 4959. kk, thanks! Is there a place we keep an agenda for tomorrow's meeting? Or should I just put stuff here. https://hackmd.io/@SamWilsn/BJbM9-c7c I'll go through and do all the grunt work if this is acceptable. Nice. But if you can't trick a few fools it takes all the fun out 😉 which means they need to start as ordinary PRs. And if they have the same number you can't tell them apart. I'd actually be happy with cataloging this year's fakes and discouraging them going forward. But we can't prevent them. If we want to just allow them in the future, how about insisting that they be _draft_ PRs on the EIP repo, and be closed _by the author_ after a few days of fun, with a status of "April Fools". Or if that is too much work, maybe a bot can close all April 1 PRs, to be reopened by the author in a few rare cases. Or something like that. **EIPIP Meeting 53** Date & Time: Wednesday, Apr 06, 2022, at 14:00 UTC Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum-cat-herders/EIPIP/issues/118

excerpts.author: gcolvin
excerpts.content:
Nice.  But if you can't trick a few fools it takes all the fun out 😉 which means they need to start as ordinary PRs.  And if they have the same number you can't tell them apart.

I'd actually be happy with cataloging this year's fakes and discouraging them going forward.  But we can't prevent them.

If we want to just allow them in the future, how about insisting that they be _draft_ PRs on the EIP repo,  and be closed  _by the author_ after a few days of fun, with a status of "April Fools".  Or if that is too much work, maybe a bot can close all April 1 PRs, to be reopened by the author in a few rare cases.  Or something like that.
